senses.gloss: kho = khu (Skt. khalu), q.v.; this, which is the Pali form, is rare in BHS: in vss, where meter requires a long syllable, Samādh 〔8.25〕; Mv 〔ii.57.22〕; but in Mv 〔iii.79.12〕 prob. read khu with v.l., and keep kadācit with mss.; in prose, Mv 〔i.144.10, 12〕; Thomas ap. Hoernle MR 〔133〕 for SP 〔327.3〕 (ed. khalu).
